text:
alex_chan: Quick heads up — TitanHW and we are targeting a joint marketplace listing + co-announcement on 2026-05-10. Legal just flagged that the marketplace listing process requires SOC2 report, latest pen test summary, completed supplier questionnaire, and accessible evidence artifacts (presigned links). Can folks confirm owners?

maya_s: Thanks Alex. Do we have a single artifact index they want or per-region bundles? Marketplace portal asked for a single tarball + per-item manifests.

sanjay_p: We usually provide a single evidence bundle for listings. Suggest: 1) SOC2 PDF, 2) Pen test executive summary + remediation attestations, 3) Redacted config screenshots, 4) KMS attestation note, 5) Questionnaire PDF.

lisa_pm: Marketing needs 2 weeks lead time for joint announcement copy. That means compliance artifacts need to be finalized by 2026-04-26. Is that feasible? :grimacing:

alex_chan: That's tight but doable if we split work. TitanHW will provide their SOC2; we need to provide our dedicated/private deployment attestation and pen test bits.

security_bot: Reminder: upload of sensitive artifacts must go through secure-s3 and use presigned URLs with 7-day TTL. See https://redwood.internal/runbook/artifact-ingest

chris_eng: I can generate the presign links. Who will be responsible for redaction? We need to scrub any customer data and internal IP from attachments.

maya_s: @chris_eng I can own redaction for config screenshots and logs. @sanjay_p can you own the pen-test summary + attestation text?

sanjay_p: Yep will draft the attestation. Question: do we include raw vuln scan outputs or just summarized results + ticket links? Marketplace usually wants summarized results and evidence that findings were remediated or on a tracked plan. Raw scan outputs should be redacted and limited.

alex_chan: Agreed — summarized + pointer to internal ticketing IDs (redacted). Legal wants an owner to sign off on the bundle. @lisa_pm can you coordinate legal/marketing for final sign-off?

lisa_pm: I will coordinate. Action items: 1) Chris generates presigned links by 2026-04-20, 2) Maya completes redaction by 2026-04-22, 3) Sanjay drafts pen-test attestation by 2026-04-18, 4) Alex to validate vendor (TitanHW) SOC2 receipt by 2026-04-19, 5) Lisa to confirm legal sign-off by 2026-04-26.

chris_eng: Working on presign script now — example we will use: ```aws s3 presign s3://rw-evidence/titanhw/2026-04-20/bundle.zip --expires-in 604800``` I will post links once done.

maya_s: Noted. For redaction I'll follow the evidence redact checklist (PII, IP, internal hostnames). If anyone wants to review redacted files before upload ping me.

sanjay_p: One ask for TitanHW: do they have a pen test scope doc we can attach? If their test covered joint deployment components we need to cross-reference. Alex can you ping their security PM?

alex_chan: Will ping their security PM now — cc @lisa_pm. Draft message: "Hi — working toward marketplace listing. Can you send SOC2 and pen-test scope + exec summary by 2026-04-15? Also confirm whether any joint infra was in scope."

security_bot: New compliance checklist created: ID RW-MKT-2026-05-TITAN. Assigned owners: alex_chan, chris_eng, maya_s, sanjay_p, lisa_pm.

lisa_pm: Also: marketing needs to coordinate embargo and logo usage with TitanHW legal. I'll open a small JIRA and assign reviewers.

chris_eng: Uploaded first presign placeholders (empty objects) so portal validators can hit links. Will replace with real objects after redaction. Links posted in private.

maya_s: 👍 I will start redaction pass today and ask for 1-hour review with @sanjay_p after I'm done.

sanjay_p: After attestation draft I'll run it by security for wording (no promises on legal language).

alex_chan: Great. If anything blocks the timeline escalate to me. Thanks team — will update here after TitanHW confirms scope. :rocket:
